bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' | grep -Fxq true || exit 70
status=0
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "import {createPostgresUnifiedStarsSales} from '../sales/pgUnifiedStarsSales.mjs';" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs || status=$((status+1))
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "  const stickerPaidPhoto=createPostgresStickerPaidPhoto({pool,telegramApi});" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs || status=$((status+2))
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "listingStore,sessionStore,receiptStore,starsLedger,unifiedStarsSales,updateStore," /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs || status=$((status+4))
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "  const starsLedger=createPostgresStarsLedger({pool,telegramApi});" /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWiring.mjs || status=$((status+8))
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "  let recoveryCursor=0,recoveryInFlight=null,workerError=null;" /opt/videobot/src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs || status=$((status+16))
docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq "    async confirmRefund(telegramTransactionId,maxPages=3)" /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgStarsLedger.mjs || status=$((status+32))
exit "$status"
